name: DatePicker
description: A date field with a calendar. Value is YYYY-MM-DD; Changed fires when a person picks, types or clears a date. On a phone or tablet the device’s own date picker opens; on a computer a keyboard-friendly calendar drops down, and if it cannot draw, the browser’s own date picker is used instead. Reused for another record (an edit sheet, a new item after the last), send Reset so the field shows that record’s day rather than the last one picked.
